mathematics.title: Engineering Mathematics-I
formulas: Matrix Rank: ρ(A) is computed by converting Matrix A into Row Echelon Form using row operations: R_i → R_i - k * R_j. Count of non-zero rows equals Rank.
Eigenvalue Equation: det(A - λI) = 0. Solving this characteristic polynomial yields eigenvalues λ_1, λ_2, ..., λ_n. Trace = Σλ_i; det(A) = Πλ_i.

Cayley-Hamilton Theorem: Any square matrix A satisfies its own characteristic equation: c_n A^n + c_{n-1} A^{n-1} + ... + c_1 A + c_0 I = 0. Use to compute Inverse: A^{-1} = -1/c_0 * (c_n A^{n-1} + ... + c_1 I).
Rolle's Theorem: If f(x) is continuous in [a, b], differentiable in (a, b), and f(a) = f(b), then there exists a point c ∈ (a, b) such that f'(c) = 0.
Lagrange Mean Value Theorem (LMVT): If f(x) is continuous in [a,b] and differentiable in (a,b), then there exists c ∈ (a,b) such that f'(c) = [f(b) - f(a)] / [b - a].
Taylor Series Expansion: f(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x-a) + f''(a)(x-a)^2 / 2! + f'''(a)(x-a)^3 / 3! + ... + f^(n)(a)(x-a)^n / n!.
Maclaurin Series (Taylor at a=0): f(x) = f(0) + f'(0)x + f''(0)x^2 / 2! + f'''(0)x^3 / 3! + ...
Lagrange Multipliers: To optimize f(x, y, z) subject to G(x, y, z) = 0, construct Lagrangian L = f + λG. Solve simultaneous system: ∇f = -λ∇G and G = 0.
memory_tricks: Rank definition: Rank is the dimension of the vector space spanned by its columns/rows. Row Echelon makes this visible directly by matching independent paths.
Eigen-sum identity: Sum of product eigenvalues equals trace (diagonal sum). Product of eigenvalues equal to determinant of matrix. Always verify with this!
Cayley-Hamilton shortcut: For 2x2 matrix, A^2 - Trace(A)*A + det(A)*I = 0. Instant polynomial check without solving det equation.
Rolle's peak logic: Continuous line starts and ends at same height must have at least one flat peak or trough where slope is zero (f'(c) = 0).
LMVT tangent parallel line: The instantaneous slope at some point 'c' must perfectly match the average slope connecting endpoints 'a' and 'b'.
Taylor's near-point approximation: Think of Taylor series like a local polynomial wrapper. To approximate values near 'a', use higher-order derivatives.
Lagrange gradient matchup: Gradients of the objective function and constraint function must point in parallel directions at optimum: ∇f || ∇G.
revision_points: Always check if a matrix is non-singular (det ≠ 0) before performing standard inversion. Singular matrices do not possess a true mathematical inverse.
In Echelon reductions, only use ROW operations. Introducing column operations changes the column space and results in wild, invalid ranks.
For Rolle's, check all 3 criteria: continuity, differentiability, and boundary parity. If even one criterion fails, Rolle's is not guaranteed.
Taylor polynomial error remainder R_n(x) can be calculated using Lagrange's remainder form: R_n(x) = f^(n+1)(c) * (x-a)^{n+1} / (n+1)!.
Lagrange Multipliers apply only to smooth continuous gradients. Ensure constraint surfaces are not self-intersecting or singular at optimum points.

physics.title: Engineering Physics
formulas: Interference (Newton's Rings): Diameter of m-th dark ring in reflected light d_m^2 = 4 * m * λ * R / μ, where R is curvature radius, μ is film index.
Diffraction Grating equation: (e + d) * sin(θ) = n * λ, where (e + d) is the grating element (lines/cm), θ is diffraction angle, n is order number.
Laser Population Kinematics: Einstein A & B coefficients relate spontaneous vs stimulated emission: B_{21} = B_{12} and A_{21} = (8π h ν^3 / c^3) * B_{21}.
Quantum Wave mechanics: Time-independent 1D Schrödinger equation: -ħ^2/(2m) * d^2ψ/dx^2 + V(x)ψ(x) = Eψ(x), where ħ is reduced Planck constant.
Numerical Aperture (NA) of fiber: NA = sin(θ_accept) = √(n1^2 - n2^2), where n1 is core index, n2 is cladding index. Fractional index difference Δ = (n1 - n2) / n1.
Acceptance Angle: θ_a = arcsin(√(n1^2 - n2^2) / n_0), where n_0 is refractive index of outside atmosphere air surrounding fiber lines.
memory_tricks: Newton's Rings ring layout: Dark rings scale with root integers (1, 2, 3...) while bright rings scale with odd roots (1, 3, 5...). Reflected phase gets a 180° shift.
Grating element density: Grating constant is 1/N, where N is lines per unit length. (e+d) is simply the distance between two adjacent slit centers.
Stimulated emission trigger: Think of stimulated emission like dominoes. One incident photon triggers another identical clone photon to exit in phase.
Schrödinger conservation check: Kinetic Energy operator (-ħ^2/2m * d^2/dx^2) plus Potential Energy operator (V) matches total systemic energy (E).
NA Light Trap condition: High NA means wide acceptance cone. To trap more light, increase the refractive index contrast between core and cladding.
revision_points: Newton's Rings center is dark in reflected light due to phase change of π (destructive interference) at air-glass interface reflection.
Diffraction limit restricts optical systems: Resolving power of grating is RP = λ / dλ = n * N, where N is absolute illuminated slit lines.
Population inversion is a non-equilibrium state where more atoms reside in high metastable state than lower ground state. Necessary for laser.
Wavefunction ψ must be continuous, single-valued, and normalizable: ∫_{-∞}^{∞} |ψ|^2 dx = 1 to have valid physical probability meaning.
Optical fibers operate entirely on Total Internal Reflection (TIR). Incident angle must exceed the core-cladding critical angle: sin(θ_c) = n2 / n1.

chemistry.title: Engineering Chemistry
formulas: Nernst Cell Potential: E_{cell} = E^0_{cell} - (R*T / n*F) * ln(Q). At standard T=298 K: E_{cell} = E^0_{cell} - (0.0592 / n) * log_{10}(Q).
Total Hardness calculation: Hardness in mg/L (as CaCO3) = [Vol of EDTA * Molarity of EDTA * 100 * 1000] / [Vol of water sample in mL].
Zeolite Hardness removal capacity: Exchange capacity of zeolite bed = [Volume of NaCl regenerated * Concentration of NaCl * CaCO3 equivalent factor].
Anodic Corrosion potential: Anodic reaction (Oxidation): M → M^{n+} + ne^-. Cathodic reaction (Reduction in acidic): 2H^+ + 2e^- → H_2.
Differential Aeration corrosion: Metal area under low oxygen concentration acts as Anode (corrodes: M → M^n+ + ne^-) while oxygenated area is Cathode.
Polymerization degree calculations: P = M_n / M_0, where M_n is basic average weight molecular size, M_0 is single monomer physical size weight.
memory_tricks: Nernst reduction layout: Q is standard products over reactants. Reactant concentration boosts cell potentials; product concentrations lower potentials.
Hardness units equivalence: 1 ppm = 1 mg/L = 0.07 Clark scale = 0.1 French scale. Remember Ca-carbonate standard weight is exactly 100 g/mol.
EDTA indicator color flip: EBT dye binds to free metal ions showing custom red. EDTA steals ions away, flipping indicator to true brilliant steel blue.
Corrosion wet rule: Corrosion occurs at anodic domains. Higher oxidation potential metals corrode preferentially. Protect using sacrificial zinc anodes.
Oxygen aeration paradox: More oxygen means less corrosion locally. Anode is the starved, deeply buried metal zone; cathode receives open air supply.
revision_points: Reference electrodes include Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE, E° = 0V) and Saturated Calomel Electrode (SCE, E = 0.242V). Use as reliable probes.
Temporary hardness is due to bicarbonates of Ca & Mg (removed easily by simple boiling); permanent is due to chlorides & sulfates.
Ion exchange demineralization produces distilled grade water since both cations and anions are completely replaced by H+ and OH-.
Cathodic protection can be sacrificial anode (galvanization using Zinc coating) or impressed current system (biasing metal negatively).
EDTA complexation must be performed under strict pH 10 buffering (NH4Cl + NH4OH mix) to stabilize Ca-EDTA and Mg-EDTA coordinate complexes.

c_programming.title: C Programming & Data Structures
formulas: Array element direct address offset: Address(A[i][j]) = Base_A + [i * Column_Count + j] * sizeof(Array_Data_Type) (Row-Major format).
Pointer Dereferencing layout: if p = &x, then *p refers directly to the value of variable x. **p represents nested pointer dereference.
Dynamic Memory expansion: void* ptr = malloc(n * sizeof(type)) allocates uninitialized bytes. calloc(n, size) initializes all bytes to zero.
Structure Size with Padding: Total Size = Σ(Field Sizes) + Compiler Padding bytes dynamically aligned to the largest element boundary.
Recursive Factorial recursion trace: T(n) = T(n-1) + C. Time Complexity: O(n); Auxiliary stack space complexity overhead is O(n).
memory_tricks: Pointer vs Value syntax: '*' at declaration is 'I am a pointer'. '*' in execution is 'Go to the address inside me and read'. '&' is 'Get my RAM address'.
Precedence: ++*p increments the value pointed to. *p++ dereferences first, then increments the pointer index to the next cell block.
Structure Padding alignment: A 4-byte int must sit on an address divisible by 4. Arrange structure fields from largest to smallest to avoid wasted gaps.
Union layout overlap: All fields in a Union share the exact same starting byte. Writing to one field immediately overwrites values in all other fields.
Stack Overflow termination: Recursion is a ladder. If you forget your bottom exit base condition, you climb till you smash the limits of call stack RAM.
revision_points: A pointer must never be dereferenced if it is NULL or uninitialized. Doing so triggers instantaneous crash segmentation faults.
Always call free(ptr) to release dynamic buffers. Dangling pointers represent massive memory leaks that slow down system processes over time.
malloc returns void*. Always check if (ptr == NULL) to handle memory allocation failures gracefully before performing array writes.
Arrays decay to pointers when passed to functions. Therefore, sizeof(array_parameter) inside a function is size of address (4/8 bytes), not array size.
Unions allocate memory equivalent only to their single largest item, whereas structures allocate cumulative spaced memory for all items.

beee.title: Basic Electrical Engineering
formulas: Kirchhoff's Laws (KVL/KCL): ΣV_{loop} = 0 (Conservation of Energy); ΣI_{node_in} = ΣI_{node_out} (Conservation of Charge).
Superposition Theorem: Current through a branch equals the algebraic sum of independent currents produced by each resource acting alone.
AC Power parameters: P_{active} = V_{rms} * I_{rms} * cos(φ) (Watts). Q_{reactive} = V_{rms} * I_{rms} * sin(φ) (VAR). S_{apparent} = V_{rms} * I_{rms} (VA).
Series RLC Resonance condition: X_L = X_C → ω L = 1 / (ω C). Resonant Frequency ω_r = 1 / √(L * C) rad/sec; f_r = 1 / [2 * π * √(L * C)] Hertz.
Quality Factor (Q-factor): Q = ω_r * L / R = 1 / [ω_r * C * R] = 1/R * √(L / C). Represents ratio of maximum energy stored to power loss.
Single Phase Transformer EMF: E = 4.44 * f * N * Φ_{max}, where f is supply frequency, N is winding turns, Φ_max is core flux density.
memory_tricks: Ohm's Triangle: V at top, I and R at bottom. Cover the variable you need to calculate to get the math formula expression automatically.
CIVIL AC Phase check: In Capacitor (C), Current (I) leads Voltage (V). In Inductor (L), Voltage (V) leads Current (I). Instantly verify angles!
Superposition source replacement: Replace ideal voltage sources with Short Circuits (0V, 0Ω). Replace ideal current sources with Open Circuits (∞Ω).
Resonance impedance behavior: At series resonance, impedance is purely resistive and minimum (Z = R). Current is maximum (I = V/R) and in-phase.
Transformer turns rule: Voltage ratio matches turns ratio exactly: V1 / V2 = N1 / N2 = I2 / I1. Mutual induction requires transient field sweeps.
revision_points: Superposition does not apply directly to Power values (P = I^2*R) because power has non-linear quadratic dependencies on currents.
Thevenin Equivalent circuit consists of a single voltage source V_th in series with resistance R_th. Find R_th by deactivating independent sources.
Power Factor (PF) is cos(φ) = R / Z. Low lagging power cause high line losses. Improve power factors using parallel capacitor banks.
Quality factor dictates bandwidth: BW = f_r / Q. High Q-factor circuits are sharply selective with narrow band filters.
Transformers cannot step up or down DC voltages because constant currents produce static non-changing magnetic flux fields (dΦ/dt = 0).

data_structures.title: Data Structures
formulas: Asymptotic Bounds (Big-O): f(n) = O(g(n)) if there exist constants c, n_0 > 0 such that 0 ≤ f(n) ≤ c*g(n) for all n ≥ n_0.
Linked List pointer updates: Node Insertion after p: new_node->next = p->next; p->next = new_node; (Constant time complexity O(1)).
Circular Queue index mapping: Enqueue index: rear = (rear + 1) % Max_Size. Dequeue index: front = (front + 1) % Max_Size.
Max nodes in Binary Tree of height h: N = 2^{h+1} - 1. Height of a perfectly balanced Binary Tree with N nodes: h = ⌈log_{2}(N+1)⌉ - 1.
Merge Sort recurrences: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n). Worst, average, and best-case complexity equal O(n log n). Space complexity equals O(n).
Hash Collision linear probing: h(k, i) = (h'(k) + i) % Table_Size. Quadratic probing: h(k, i) = (h'(k) + c1*i + c2*i^2) % Table_Size.
memory_tricks: LIFO vs FIFO logic: Stack is a cafeteria plate stack (LIFO - Last In First Out). Queue is a real retail ticket queue line (FIFO - First In First Out).
Infix to Postfix conversions: Operators are delayed symbols. Push operators to a stack, pop and output when lower precedence symbols appear.
BST left/right boundaries: In Binary Search Trees, left sub-tree values are strictly smaller than root; right sub-tree values are strictly larger.
Tree Traversal paths: Pre-Order is (Root, Left, Right). In-Order is (Left, Root, Right) - always outputs sorted keys for BST! Post-Order is (Left, Right, Root).
Quick Sort pivot lock: Quick Sort pivots work like partitions separating high and low domains. Average is O(n log n); unbalanced worst is O(n^2).
revision_points: Sequential search is O(n); Binary Search is O(log n) but demands a fully sorted pre-allocated array dataset.
Doubly linked lists store previous node references, simplifying backward navigations at the cost of larger per-node memory parameters.
Queue overflow vs empty checks: Circular Queue is full when: (rear + 1) % Max_Size == front. It is empty when: rear == front.
A tree with N nodes always possesses exactly N - 1 edges. Removing any single edge breaks connectivity and forms disjoint graph components.
Chaining collision resolution handles overflow gracefully by appending dynamic storage lists to duplicate hash index locations.

english.title: Communicative English
formulas: Subject-Verb Agreement (Concord): Singular subjects demand singular verbs; plural subjects demand plural verbs. Exceptions: Collective nouns.
Email structural layout blueprint: [Subject line clear] → [Salutation] → [Context/Opening] → [Actionable Details] → [Closing signature].
Direct to Indirect Voicing shifts: Active: Subject + Verb + Object. Passive: Object + Auxiliary Verb + Past Participle + by + Subject.
Paragraph Cohesion ratio: Topic Sentence (Theme statement) + Supporting Sentences (Expansions) + Concluding Sentence (Bridge transitions).
memory_tricks: FANBOYS coordinating links: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So. Use to connect independent clauses in compound sentences correctly.
Technical brevity rule: Keep sentential limits below 20 words. Simplify complex descriptions into direct action-driven sentences.
Subject Verb separation trap: Ignore parenthetical modifiers ('along with', 'as well as'). Verb must agree purely with the principal subject.
Passive usage trigger: Use passive voice when the actor is unknown, or if the mechanical action is more critical than the person performing it.
revision_points: Always write concise, action-oriented email subjects. Never send empty subjects as they trigger SPAM filtering rules.
Keep resumes clean and readable. Use chronological order for educational details, highlighting metrics over vague generic summaries.
Common grammatical error: Run-on sentences. Avoid splicing independent clauses using simple commas. Place a semicolon or period.
Use transitional phrases ('Furthermore', 'Consequently', 'On the contrary') to guide readers smoothly across paragraph shifts.

engineering_graphics.title: Engineering Graphics
formulas: Representative Fraction: RF = [Dimension of Object on Drawing] / [Actual Physical Dimension of the Object]. Dimensionally uniform fraction.
Diagonal Scale alignment: Length of Scale (LOS) = RF * [Maximum length to be measured by scale]. Spaced out to read up to three units.
Conic Eccentricity formulation: e = [Distance of point from Focus] / [Distance of point from Directrix]. e < 1 (Ellipse), e = 1 (Parabola), e > 1 (Hyperbola).
Line projection lengths: True Length (TL) relates to apparent lengths: TL^2 = [Front View length]^2 + [Plan view length]^2.
Isometric Scale sizing ratio: Isometric Length (Iso L) = √(2/3) * True Length ≈ 0.816 * True Length.
memory_tricks: RF units check: Convert both drawing distances and real-world dimensions to the exact same units (typically mm) before dividing to isolate RF.
Diagonal scale rise angle: Use diagonal line divisions to divide tiny scale divisions into exactly 10 equal parts using properties of similar triangles.
Quadrant viewing mnemonic: First Angle Projection has Front View above line, Top View below line. Observe from Top, project downward.
True Length projection traces: When a straight line is inclined to both HP and VP, its front view is shorter than true length, inclined at apparent angle α.
Isometric visual tilt: Isometric view uses standard true scales. Isometric projection scales down by 180° rotation projections (0.82 ratio).
revision_points: Always ensure scales are drawn with units explicitly labeled. Leave sufficient margins for dimensions to avoid paper clutter.
In first angle projections, the Left-Side View is projected on the Right-Profile Plane, positioned right of the front view layout.
When a plane is parallel to HP, its True Shape is visible in the Top View. Its Front View collapses into a single parallel straight line.
Identify solid projection variables: Section planes cutting solid shapes creates truncated surfaces. Lateral surface boundaries determine patterns.
Continuous thick lines represent visible contour lines. Dashed medium lines represent hidden edges. Chain thin lines indicate central axes.

bcme.title: Basic Civil and Mechanical Engineering
formulas: Stress & Strain definitions: Stress σ = Normal Force / Area (N/m² or Pa). Strain ε = δL / L (Dimensionless ratio). Modulus E = σ / ε.
Hooke's Law bounds: σ = E * ε, valid up to Elastic Limit parameters on stress-strain engineering diagrams.
Thermal Efficiency bounds: Carnot: η_c = 1 - T_{cold}/T_{hot}. Otto Cycle: η_o = 1 - 1 / r^{γ-1}, where r is compression ratio.
Power transmitted by Belts: P = (T_1 - T_2) * v (Watts), where T_1 is tight side tension, T_2 is slack side tension, v is linear speed.
Refrigeration performance metric: COP = Q_{cold} / W_{input}. Ideal COP_{refrigerator} = T_{cold} / (T_{hot} - T_{cold}).
memory_tricks: Stress is internal pushback: Stress is not the external force itself. It is the internal restoring pushback force per unit area in the material.
Modulus memory map: modulus of elasticity is structural stiffness. Higher E-value means high modulus (steel is stiffer/more elastic than rubber).
Four Stroke movement chain: Intake (Suck), Compression (Squeeze), Power (Bang), Exhaust (Blow). Cycle covers two complete revolutions.
Carnot thermodynamic ceiling: No thermal engine operating between two given hot-cold reservoirs can exceed Carnot's efficiency limits.
COP vs Efficiency logic: COP can exceed 1 because we are moving energy instead of converting it fully from heat parameters.
revision_points: Stress-strain curve key points: Proportional limit, Elastic limit, Yield point, Ultimate strength point, Rupture/Breaking point.
Concrete possesses high compressive strengths but fails easily in tension. Reinforce concrete bases using steel rods (RCC setup).
Four-stroke engines produce one power stroke every 2 full revolutions, whereas two-stroke engines produce power on every single rotation.
Refrigerants must possess low boiling points, high latent heats of vaporization, and non-toxic parameters (e.g. eco friendly hydrofluorocarbons).
Power transmission belt slip reduces output speeds. Use toothed belts or gear trains to guarantee synchronous solid transmissions.
